title: Advanced Risk Management
description: This module equips specialist DFV practitioners with advanced skills in assessing, monitoring, and responding to high-risk and rapidly changing domestic and family violence situations. It focuses on lethality assessment, multi-agency risk panels, and dynamic risk monitoring.
outcomes: Conduct advanced lethality assessments using specialist frameworks
Participate effectively in multi-agency risk panels and high-risk teams
Monitor and respond to dynamic and rapidly changing DFV risk
